toolbar.drag.tooltip: Drag (Q): Click objects to select them and drag them to move them freely; Ctrl+click and Ctrl+drag select several.
@toolbar.drag.tooltip: The shortcut key in the tooltip is the same in every language
toolbar.move.tooltip: Move (W): Move the selection along axis arrows: east, north and in 3D up. Shift moves in whole metres. Press W again to let the arrows follow the object's heading.
toolbar.rotate.tooltip: Rotate (E): Turn the selected object: the round handle from above, the rings in 3D. Shift snaps to 15°.
toolbar.delete.tooltip: Delete (Del): Delete the selection. Objects that other parts of the map refer to stay.
toolbar.road.tooltip: Road (R): Build roads from the view from above: click to start, click for each bend, Esc ends. Roads join free spline ends.
toolbar.rows.tooltip: Rows (T): Lay rows of objects along roads, such as lamps or posts: choose an object, point at a road and click.
toolbar.terrain.tooltip: Terrain (G): Shape the ground with a brush held over it, raising, lowering, smoothing, flattening or roughening it, or lay a ramp between two clicks.
toolbar.markings.tooltip: Markings (M): Draw road markings on junctions made in this project: click an anchor, then another; click a line to change or delete it.
toolbar.priority.tooltip: Priority (V): Set the right of way at junctions: click a junction, then the sign of an arm to switch it between normal, main road and give way.
toolbar.lanes.tooltip: Lanes (L): Choose which lane leads to which through a junction made in this project: click a lane in, then a lane out to add or remove the way between them.
toolbar.objects.tooltip: Objects (3): Place scenery objects: choose one, then click into the map. Shift+click keeps placing, R turns it, Esc stops.
